name: mittwald-agent-skills
description: Various workflows for deploying, running or migrating your projects on mittwald mStudio.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and migrate projects to mittwald mStudio
interface.longDescription: Bundles the mittwald-migrate and mittwald-zerodeploy skills together with the hosted mittwald MCP server. mittwald-migrate guides a conversational, phase-by-phase migration of an application from Kubernetes, Docker Compose, a VPS or another hoster to mittwald mStudio. mittwald-zerodeploy performs zero-config deployments to mStudio container hosting using Railpack build inference.
interface.developerName: mittwald CM Service GmbH & Co. KG
defaultPrompt: Deploy this repository to mittwald mStudio.
Migrate my Docker Compose stack to mittwald mStudio.
